from speech_models import TranscriptEvent, TranscriptSegment, normalize_transcript_events


def handle_partial_and_final_events(events: Iterable[TranscriptEvent]) -> List[TranscriptSegment]:
    normalized = normalize_transcript_events(events)
    segments: List[TranscriptSegment] = []
    current_text = []
    for event in normalized:
        if event.is_partial:
            current_text = [event.text]
            segments.append(TranscriptSegment(text=event.text, is_final=False, confidence=event.confidence))
        else:
            text = event.text if event.text else " ".join(current_text)
            segments.append(TranscriptSegment(text=text, is_final=True, confidence=event.confidence))
            current_text = []
    return segments

","speech_client.py":"import asyncio
import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Dict, Optional

import websockets

from speech_models import AudioChunk, SpeechConfig, TranscriptEvent, normalize_transcript_events


@dataclass
class StreamingSpeechClient:
    api_key: str
    region: str
    endpoint: str
    model: str = "speech-to-text"

    async def _connect(self) -> Any:
        url = f"wss://{self.region}.stt.speech.microsoft.com/speech/recognition/conversation/cognitiveservices/v1?language=en-US"
        return await websockets.connect(url, extra_headers={"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": self.api_key})

    async def stream_chunks(self, chunks: AsyncIterable[AudioChunk], language_code: str = "en-US") -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptEvent]:
        ws = await self._connect()
        try:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "config", "language": language_code, "model": self.model}))
            async for chunk in chunks:
                await ws.send(chunk.audio)
                if chunk.is_final:
                    await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "end"}))
            while True:
                message = await ws.recv()
                if isinstance(message, bytes):
                    continue
                data = json.loads(message)
                if data.get("type") in {"partial", "final"}:
                    yield TranscriptEvent(text=data.get("text", ""), is_partial=data.get("type") == "partial", confidence=data.get("confidence"))
                if data.get("type") == "end":
                    break
        finally:
            await ws.close()

    async def stream_microphone(self, sample_rate_hz: int = 16000, language_code: str = "en-US") -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptEvent]:
        async def mic_source() -> AsyncIterator[AudioChunk]:
            yield AudioChunk(audio=b"", is_final=True)
        async for event in self.stream_chunks(mic_source(), language_code=language_code):
            yield event

    async def stream_with_language(self, language_code: str = "en-US", enable_punctuation: bool = True) -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptEvent]:
        config = SpeechConfig(language_code=language_code, enable_punctuation=enable_punctuation)
        async def empty_chunks() -> AsyncIterator[AudioChunk]:
            yield AudioChunk(audio=b"", is_final=True)
        async for event in self.stream_chunks(empty_chunks(), language_code=config.language_code):
            yield event


def get_speech_client() -> StreamingSpeechClient:
    api_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY", "")
    region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION", "eastus")
    endpoint = f"https://{region}.stt.speech.microsoft.com"
    return StreamingSpeechClient(api_key=api_key, region=region, endpoint=endpoint)
","speech_models.py":"from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, List, Optional


@dataclass
class AudioChunk:
    audio: bytes
    is_final: bool = False


@dataclass
class SpeechConfig:
    language_code: str = "en-US"
    enable_punctuation: bool = True


@dataclass
class TranscriptEvent:
    text: str
    is_partial: bool = False
    confidence: Optional[float] = None
    metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class TranscriptSegment:
    text: str
    is_final: bool = True
    confidence: Optional[float] = None


def normalize_transcript_events(events: Iterable[TranscriptEvent]) -> List[TranscriptEvent]:
    normalized: List[TranscriptEvent] = []
    for event in events:
        normalized.append(TranscriptEvent(text=(event.text or "").strip(), is_partial=bool(event.is_partial), confidence=event.confidence, metadata=dict(event.metadata)))
    return normalized

import os
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator

from speech_models import TranscriptEvent
from deep_translator import GoogleTranslator


async def live_caption_translate(events: AsyncIterable[TranscriptEvent], target_language: str = "es") -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptEvent]:
    translator = GoogleTranslator(source="auto", target=target_language)
    async for event in events:
        translated = translator.translate(event.text) if event.text else ""
        yield TranscriptEvent(text=translated, is_partial=event.is_partial, confidence=event.confidence, metadata={**event.metadata, "target_language": target_language})

from speech_models import TranscriptEvent
from openai import OpenAI


class CaptionSafetyChecker:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)

    def check(self, events: Iterable[TranscriptEvent]) -> List[dict]:
        results = []
        for event in events:
            moderation = self.client.moderations.create(model="omni-moderation-latest", input=event.text)
            flagged = bool(moderation.results[0].flagged)
            results.append({"text": event.text, "flagged": flagged, "categories": moderation.results[0].categories.model_dump()})
        return results

from speech_models import TranscriptEvent


class MeetingSummarizer:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)

    def summarize(self, events: Iterable[TranscriptEvent]) -> str:
        transcript = "\n".join(event.text for event in events if event.text)
        response = self.client.responses.create(model="gpt-4.1-mini", input=f"Summarize this meeting transcript clearly and concisely:\n{transcript}")
        return response.output_text

from openai import OpenAI
from speech_models import TranscriptEvent


class CaptionEmbedder:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)

    def embed(self, events: Iterable[TranscriptEvent]) -> List[List[float]]:
        texts = [event.text for event in events if event.text]
        if not texts:
            return []
        response = self.client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=texts)
        return [item.embedding for item in response.data]
